sentences.text: In the meantime, the order dated 8-10-2015, passed by the learned SDJM Danapur, Patna, in connection with Complaint Case No. 859C of 2015, whereby cognizance has been taken under Section 498A of the IPC and Section 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, shall remain stayed.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioner Nos. 1 and 3 are sister-in-law (Nanad)
of the OP No. 2, petitioner Nos. 2 and 4 are husband of petitioner Nos. 1 and 3 respectively, and petitioner No. 5 is maternal nephew of the husband of the OP No. 2.
It is next submitted that whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife, the entire family members are implicated in a mechanical manner with general and omnibus allegations.
